maddeler.e:
توافدت (form VI)
# تَوَافَدْتُ (tawāfadtu) /ta.waː.fad.tu/: first-person singular past active of تَوَافَدَ (tawāfada)
# تَوَافَدْتَ (tawāfadta) /ta.waː.fad.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of تَوَافَدَ (tawāfada)
# تَوَافَدْتِ (tawāfadti) /ta.waː.fad.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of تَوَافَدَ (tawāfada)
# تَوَافَدَتْ (tawāfadat) /ta.waː.fa.dat/: third-person fem
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
